decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (PL/VP/2192/MR/01, PL/VP/2192/MR/02, PL/VP/2192/MR/03, PL/VP/2192/MR/04,  PL/VP/2192/MR/05,  PL/VP/2192/MR/05, Received 23 June 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The north facing bathroom window hereby approved shall be installed using obscured glass, only the top part shall be openable and the window shall be so retained permanently.
description: Erection of single storey rear extensions to the ground floor flat
